enonce_intro_markdown:
**SECTION D: ESSAY (10 MARKS)**

Choose ONE topic from those below and write an essay of between 150-180 words.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 1**

You have just obtained your BEPC examination and your parents who live in the village have chosen a wife/husband for you to get married to but you don't want him/her. Write a letter to them informing them why you think the marriage will not take place. You are Ngah Sylvie of P S S Kumba and your Post Office Box number is 45. In this letter you should write about:
- Your age,
- Your future,
- Your choice of a wife/husband.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre personnelle adressée à des proches (ici les parents) suit une structure fixe que les correcteurs du MINESEC attendent précisément : l'adresse de l'expéditeur et la date en haut à droite, une formule d'appel adaptée au destinataire (« Dear Mum and Dad »), un corps de lettre organisé en paragraphes qui traitent chacun un point de la consigne, une formule de politesse de clôture adaptée au registre familial, puis la signature (prénom seul, cohérent avec le lien affectif). Contrairement à une lettre formelle administrative, le registre reste chaleureux et direct, mais respectueux : on s'adresse à ses parents, pas à un inconnu.

La consigne impose trois points à traiter : l'âge de la candidate, son avenir, et son choix personnel d'époux - chacun mérite son propre paragraphe pour que le correcteur les identifie clairement.

**Modèle de lettre (entre 150 et 180 mots) :**

P.O. Box 45
Kumba
12th August 2019

Dear Mum and Dad,

I hope this letter finds you in good health. I am writing to talk to you about the marriage you have arranged for me, because I do not think it should take place.

First of all, I am still very young. I have just obtained my BEPC and I believe I need more years to grow, both in age and in maturity, before taking on the responsibilities of marriage.

Secondly, I have a future to build. I intend to pursue my studies up to university level and find a good job so that I can support myself and, later, support you as well. Getting married now would put an end to these plans.

Finally, I would like to choose my own husband myself, when the time is right. I want to marry someone I know and love, not someone chosen for me without my consent.

I hope you will understand my reasons and reconsider your decision. I remain your loving and respectful daughter.

Yours affectionately,
Sylvie

*(environ 170 mots)*

### Conseil
Compte tes mots pendant la rédaction, pas seulement à la fin : viser un paragraphe d'environ 40-45 mots par point de la consigne te place naturellement dans la fourchette 150-180 mots sans avoir à couper du texte au dernier moment.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 2**

The National Week of Bilingualism was celebrated in your school and many activities were carried out. Say how it was done. In your essay you may:
- Say what bilingualism is,
- When is it celebrated in Cameroon,
- Activities that were carried out,
- Who the participants are,
- The importance of Bilingualism to an individual, to Cameroon and to the whole world.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai descriptif/informatif (comme le compte-rendu d'un événement scolaire) suit une structure en trois temps : une introduction qui présente le sujet et pose le cadre (quoi, quand, où), un développement qui traite chaque point imposé par la consigne dans des paragraphes distincts et ordonnés logiquement, et une conclusion qui résume l'importance du sujet. Contrairement à la dissertation argumentative, il ne s'agit pas de défendre une thèse mais de rapporter des faits et d'en expliquer la portée - le ton reste informatif, à la troisième personne ou en « we » si l'élève parle au nom de son école.

La consigne impose cinq points : définition du bilinguisme, date de célébration, activités menées, participants, importance - chacun devient un paragraphe court plutôt que d'être noyé dans un seul bloc de texte.

**Modèle d'essai (entre 150 et 180 mots) :**

Bilingualism is the ability to speak and understand two languages fluently. In Cameroon, it specifically refers to mastering both English and French, our two official languages.

The National Week of Bilingualism is celebrated every year during the last week of January. This year, my school organised several activities to mark the event.

Among the activities carried out were bilingual debates, poem recitals in both English and French, a quiz competition on Cameroonian culture, and a march past where students wore the colours of our national flag. Teachers and students from both linguistic backgrounds worked together to prepare these activities.

The participants included students from all levels, teachers, the school administration, and even some parents who came to support their children.

Bilingualism is very important. For an individual, it opens more opportunities for study and employment. For Cameroon, it strengthens national unity between English-speaking and French-speaking citizens. For the whole world, it promotes communication and understanding between different cultures.

*(environ 165 mots)*

### Piège à éviter
Ne transforme pas ce sujet en lettre ou en discours : la consigne demande un essai (« write an essay »), donc pas de formule d'appel (« Dear... ») ni d'adresse en en-tête, seulement une introduction, un développement structuré et une conclusion.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 3**

You are a member of the Health Club in your school and you discover that your classmate is suffering from HIV/AIDS. He no longer comes to school because he is very sick and his family members and school mates have rejected him. Write a speech to be presented during the Youth Week celebration encouraging your mates to accept people living with the illness. In your speech, you should:
- Say what HIV/AIDS is,
- Give the different means of transmission, its symptoms and how it can be prevented,
- Talk about tolerance and acceptance in school,
- Suggest some of the things people living with the illness can do to avoid being stigmatised. Your name is Osong Ako. Your school is GBHS Nkura and your Post Office Box number is 215.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours (speech) s'adresse directement à un auditoire réel, identifié par la consigne (ici les camarades pendant la Semaine de la Jeunesse). Sa structure impose : une formule d'ouverture qui salue l'auditoire (« Good morning/afternoon, dear schoolmates » ou équivalent), une brève annonce du sujet, un développement qui traite chaque point demandé en s'adressant directement aux auditeurs (usage de « you », de questions rhétoriques, d'exhortations), et une formule de clôture qui remercie l'auditoire. Le ton est engageant et persuasif, à la différence de l'essai descriptif qui reste informatif et impersonnel.

La consigne impose quatre points : définition du VIH/SIDA, modes de transmission/symptômes/prévention, tolérance et acceptation à l'école, conseils pour éviter la stigmatisation - chacun devient une partie clairement identifiable du discours.

**Modèle de discours (entre 150 et 180 mots) :**

Good morning, dear schoolmates. Today, I want to talk to you about something very important: HIV/AIDS and how we should treat those who live with it.

HIV/AIDS is a serious illness caused by a virus that attacks the body's immune system. It is transmitted mainly through unprotected sexual intercourse, contact with infected blood, and from an infected mother to her child. Common symptoms include continuous weight loss, persistent fever, and general body weakness. It can be prevented by practising safe sex, avoiding the sharing of sharp objects, and going for regular medical check-ups.

Sadly, one of our classmates is currently suffering from this illness, and instead of supporting him, some of you have rejected him. This is wrong. HIV/AIDS is not transmitted through friendship, sharing a classroom, or shaking hands.

Let us show tolerance and acceptance. People living with HIV/AIDS should keep taking their medication, eat a balanced diet, and surround themselves with supportive friends, so they are never made to feel ashamed of their condition.

Thank you for listening.

*(environ 175 mots)*

### Piège à éviter
Une formule d'ouverture et de clôture n'est pas optionnelle dans un discours : l'oublier fait perdre des points de forme même si le contenu est excellent, car le correcteur évalue aussi le respect du format imposé.
